fact: In a reply to parliamentary question NW6007, the Acting Minister of Police states that SAPS compiles quarterly crime statistics from dockets registered on its CAS/ICDMS case systems and releases them, while having halted the women-and-children breakdown over data inconsistencies; the reply is undated, so the question date of 31 December 2025 is used.

Stats SA published its first Statistics of insolvencies release (P0043.2) on 21 July 2026, covering June 2026 with a series from January 2023, compiled from insolvency data supplied by the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (320 insolvencies in Q2 2026).
